settings.title: Return Policies
settings.content:
Returns will be accepted for up to 10 days of Customer’s receipt or tracking number on unworn items. You, as a Customer, are obliged to inform us via email before you return the item, only in the case of:

– Received the wrong item.
– Item arrived not as expected (ie. damaged packaging).
– Item had defects.
– Over delivery time.
– The shipper does not allow the goods to be inspected before payment.

The returned product(s) must be in the original packaging, safety wrapped, undamaged and unworn. This means that the item(s) must be safely packed in a carton box for protection during transport, possibly the same carton used to ship to you as a customer.

settings.title: Crafted in Pearls, Defined by Grace

settings.txt_content:
Each piece is carefully crafted from freshwater and baroque pearls, set in sterling silver or 18k gold vermeil. Pearls are chosen for their natural luster and individuality, ensuring every creation is unique. Light and graceful, these jewelry pieces are designed for daily wear, layering, and timeless elegance.

Pearl Mission is for those who cherish meticulous design and subtle luxury. Our jewelry accompanies you through quiet moments, celebratory gatherings, and daily rituals alike. Every pearl reflects your story—a symbol of patience, resilience, and enduring beauty—crafted to inspire effortless elegance in everyday life.

settings.faq_content_1: Yes. We use genuine freshwater pearls and baroque pearls. Each pearl is naturally formed and selected for its luster and character, making every piece unique.
settings.faq_title_2: Will my jewelry look exactly like the photos?
settings.faq_content_2: Due to the natural nature of pearls, slight variations in shape, size, texture, and luster may occur. These differences are part of the beauty of natural pearls and are not considered defects.
settings.faq_title_3: What materials are used in your jewelry?
settings.faq_content_3: Our jewelry is crafted using sterling silver or 18k gold vermeil, paired with carefully selected freshwater and baroque pearls.
settings.faq_title_4: Is gold vermeil durable for daily wear?
settings.faq_content_4: Yes. Our 18k gold vermeil jewelry features a thick gold layer over sterling silver. With proper care, it is suitable for daily wear. To extend its lifespan, avoid frequent contact with chemicals, water, and hard surfaces.
settings.faq_title_5: How should I care for my pearl jewelry?
settings.faq_content_5: We recommend storing your jewelry separately, avoiding contact with perfumes, cosmetics, and cleaning products, and gently wiping it with a soft cloth after wear to maintain its luster.
